layout: A single handwritten correction list runs from p426 through p468. Page references occupy a narrow left column; a long nearly vertical rule separates it from the corrections, and a second long rule bounds the right. Several long corrections extend to or beyond the right rule. Continuation rows occur at p428, p440, p449 and p462. The two p440 groups, the final p447 group, the raised one and small baseline body at p449, and the old p466 reference are cancelled or partly cancelled. There are no diagrams and no independent mathematical display. The p438 closing parenthesis is inline. The p455 three-level mark lies directly under the first i of divided. The list is in one principal hand; the archive 31 is lighter and differently formed. Pale circular impressions and broad paper texture in the right margin are material features, not redrawn as ink. The definite isolated dark bodies are preserved geometrically with origin unassigned. The two long rules are anchored beside the text, with paler lower portions. Inventory coverage: 67 correction entries, all nested deletions/insertion/underline and mark groups, both long rules, and the archive comment.

brief_feedback: The supplied H file has status desc, so no H comparison rows or H textual claims were manufactured. Whole and each half were displayed exactly once, then 23 loci were frozen and cropped with the supplied script; every crop was displayed singly once. No OCR, recognition, outside research, other pages/readers, compilation or mathematical proof was used. math_checks is therefore empty. Seven explicit C uncertainty macros have decisions, together with six supplied context confirmations. The proposed reading adds the required cote header and only standard LaTeX/TikZ layout scaffolding: a no-indent group, column spacing, continuation indents and anchors for the two observed rules. Such scaffolding is not counted as a separate ink difference. Every nonempty c field is a literal excerpt of the original C, and every reading field in changes occurs in reading.tex. Several small-body drawings leave material/ink origin unassigned; their placement and existence, rather than punctuation function, are the reported observations.
